features.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `half`, `bfloat16`, `float32`, `float64`.
constraints: features must be one of half, bfloat16, float32, float64
features must have a broadcast-compatible shape with (scale * alpha)

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `features`.

constraints: alpha and scale are internal constants from the initializer
